exposure: pathogenic microorganisms (CONS, Candida, Bacteriod spp., Staph., Proteus)
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women from Babylon Province, with 50 women having vaginal infections (patients) and 50 without (controls).
finding: The study found that pregnant women with vaginal infections had significantly increased fetal weight, decreased maternal age and duration time, and elevated percentages of C/S and PROM compared to controls.
mod_finding: The study showed an elevation in the percentages of C/S in pregnant women with vaginal infections compared to those without.
